description: This file defines the CustomField class for managing custom fields related to customers in the OpenCart system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving custom fields, as well as managing their descriptions, values, and associated customer groups.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Model class for managing customer custom fields in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Adds a new custom field and its descriptions, customer group associations, and values based on the provided data.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field's details, descriptions, associations, and values.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Deletes a custom field and all related descriptions, customer group associations, and values.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom field, including descriptions.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves a list of custom fields with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomFields
methods.description: Returns the total number of custom fields present.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a custom field in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions in all custom fields for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a custom field with a customer group, optionally marking it as required.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Fetches all customer groups linked to a particular custom field.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new value option for a custom field.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all value options for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom field value, including descriptions.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific custom field value.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches value descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds or updates a description for a custom field value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific custom field value.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

search-terms: Customer group associations in custom fields
